handoff.salientSummary: Round 1 user testing of foh-core: 109 assertions tested through the real surfaces (17 flow validators, 5 batches) — 96 pass, 13 fail, 0 blocked. Failures need fix features: VAL-FND-006 (expired holds in existingHolds), VAL-FND-009 (per-step oracle), VAL-SETUP-020/021 (UI delete 404s), VAL-SETUP-023 (UI block create 500), VAL-SETUP-025 (conflicts panel unmapped payload), VAL-BOOK-003/008/009/013 (detail sheet + filters), VAL-BOOK-037 (raw English status enums in Arabic), VAL-HOST-014 (arrived→seat ignores tableIds), VAL-CROSS-006 (block 500, no reflow notice).
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Ran the user-testing validation round for milestone foh-core. Determined the 109 testable assertions from the foh-core features' fulfills (Setup 32, Reservation book 38, Host stand 28, FND-006/009/024, GUEST-022/025, CROSS-001..006), started App (3001) and Sites (3008) alongside the pre-existing tenant-api US (3007) and KSA (3009), seeded demo reservations and guestbook data for acme and riyadh-grill, built an operator-token mint helper for the curl/terminal groups, and wrote the round's isolation registry, guidance sections and concurrency plan into library/user-testing.md. Spawned 17 flow-validator subagents over 5 batches (max 3 browsers) across terminal, curl, sqlite, agent-browser and Playwright surfaces, independently re-verified the two highest-risk findings, synthesized all 17 flow reports, wrote validation/foh-core/user-testing/synthesis.json and updated validation-state.json, then stopped the two dev servers it started.
handoff.whatWasLeftUndone: No fix features were created (orchestrator's step); the 13 failed assertions are marked failed in validation-state.json with root causes and file:line evidence so fix features can be written directly. The guest-side clause of VAL-CROSS-006 cannot be exercised until the guest-channels-and-crm milestone implements /reservations/manage (both tenant-api and Sites routes 404 today); it is recorded inside the failed assertion rather than as a separate blocker. One environment issue needs a mission-owner decision: local D1's system-level reservations.enabled row is true while data.db has false, so the contract's flag-off precondition does not hold locally (workaround documented in library/user-testing.md). No second user-testing round was run.

tests.coverage: This round authored no test files; it exercised the product through its real surfaces. Existing suites were run as assertion evidence: @repo/reservations engine + package tests (g1), tenant-api reservations-setup tests (g2), and an App Playwright spec (g7). Everything else was verified live against App 3001, Sites 3008 and tenant-api 3007/3009 with agent-browser sessions, curl and read-only sqlite probes.

discoveredIssues.description: VAL-FND-006: the engine honours I4 for holds passed in input.holds but not for holds passed through existingHolds — searchAvailability folds them in without filtering expiresAt (packages/reservations/src/availability.ts:395-435) and the kind==='hold' branch of the assignment path has no expiry filter (packages/reservations/src/assign.ts:370-420), unlike the loop at :414. Expired holds therefore keep consuming capacity.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Filter existingHolds by expiresAt before folding them into occupancies in searchAvailability, and add the same expiry check to the kind==='hold' branch in assign.ts; add an engine test that an expired hold does not block a slot.

discoveredIssues.description: VAL-SETUP-020: the UI pacing-rule Delete builds a location-scoped path /locations/:id/pacing/:ruleId (apps/app/app/utils/reservations/setup-api.ts:1958-1966) while tenant-api registers DELETE only at /pacing/:id (apps/tenant-api/src/routes/operator-reservations-setup.ts:1482-1507), so deleting a pacing rule from Settings > Services returns 404.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Point the client at /pacing/:ruleId, or register the location-scoped DELETE on the server; keep the API and UI paths identical.

discoveredIssues.description: VAL-SETUP-021: the same path-shape mismatch for service availability — the UI deletes via /locations/:id/service-availability/:id (setup-api.ts:2045-2053) but tenant-api only registers /service-availability/:id (operator-reservations-setup.ts:1644-1649), returning 404.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Align the client path with the registered route (or add the alias) and cover the delete in the setup UI test.

discoveredIssues.description: VAL-SETUP-023 and part of VAL-CROSS-006: creating a table block through the UI always returns HTTP 500 — the form posts startMin/endMin and createBlockForLocation assigns a localToInstant() resolution object into the numeric start_at/end_at columns (apps/tenant-api/src/services/rsv-setup-crud.ts:3049-3056).
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Convert the resolved LocalInstant to epoch milliseconds before the insert (or accept startMin/endMin and resolve internally); add a Vitest case that posts the UI payload shape.

discoveredIssues.description: VAL-SETUP-025: the conflicts panel on /acme/reservations/settings renders rows as '· (p)' because it reads confirmationCode/businessDate/partySize/reason (setup-api.ts:124-141, settings._index.tsx:855-876) while the endpoint returns kind/bookingId/tableId|serviceId/details.businessDate and fetchSetupConflicts raw-casts the response without mapping.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Map the engine conflict items to the DTO the panel renders (or render kind plus details.businessDate directly) and add a Playwright case with a non-empty conflicts list instead of the stubbed empty array.

discoveredIssues.description: VAL-HOST-014: the arrived→seated path claims an assignment that is never persisted — the App sends tableIds in the status transition but transitionReservationStatus in apps/tenant-api/src/services/rsv-booking-service.ts ignores them, so POST /status returns 200 and sets seatedAt while no rsv_table_occupancies row is created and the day feed keeps tableIds=[].
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Read tableIds in the status transition and run the same assignment/occupancy write the /assign path uses; assert an occupancy row exists after seating from the floor.

discoveredIssues.description: VAL-BOOK-003/008/009/013: the Book surface is incomplete versus the contract — the detail sheet renders no occasion, no dining-area name and no source, and its audit entries carry no timestamps (it never calls /book/reservations/:id/events); the day query ignores serviceId so the service selector does not narrow rows; there are no party/cover counters and no source or tag filters; the area filter does not narrow.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Thread serviceId (and area/source/tag) through the day query and apply them, add the header counters, render occasion/dining area/source plus event timestamps from the events endpoint in the detail sheet, and give the phone booking sheet a free-text dietary field.

discoveredIssues.description: VAL-BOOK-037: in the Arabic UI the status and course badges still render raw English enums (booked, confirmed, arrived, seated, finished, no_show, cancelled) at apps/app/app/routes/_app+/$orgSlug_+/reservations+/today.tsx:376,507,590, book.tsx:449,453 and detail-sheet.tsx:403; everything else in the RTL pass (dir, tabs, filters, quick actions, LTR-correct codes/times) is correct.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Translate the status/course label maps with Lingui messages and extract them into the ar catalog.

discoveredIssues.description: VAL-CROSS-006: after a block, a soft booking is auto-reassigned and emits auto_reassigned with from/to table ids, but no move notice reaches hosts (the day feed has no moveNotices key and the timeline shows 'Automatic Reflow Notices 0'), and a locked booking displaced by the block is not surfaced in the timeline's Unassigned & Conflicts panel (badge 0) even though the settings conflicts endpoint reports it as blocked_table.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Surface reflow moves (including auto_reassigned events) and displaced locked bookings in the host feed/timeline conflict panel; the block-creation 500 above must be fixed first for the UI path to be testable.

discoveredIssues.description: VAL-FND-009: the sequence property suite verifies I1-I8 after every step and the day-scenario suite compares against the brute-force oracle, but the oracle is called once per day scenario (apps/tenant-api/src/services/engine.property.test.ts:45), not after every step of executeOperationSequence as the assertion's wording requires. Test-side gap, not user-visible behavior.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Call bruteForceAssignExists (or its per-step check) after each step of the sequence generator for small floors, or amend the assertion wording to match the two-suite design.

discoveredIssues.description: Local D1's system-level reservations.enabled row is true while packages/database/db/data.db has false, so deleting the organization rows does not hide the module and the validation contract's flag-off precondition silently fails; the App watchdog also restores .wrangler/state rows to true within about 40 s of a write.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Set the system-level ConfigFlag row to false in apps/app/.wrangler/state (or document the workaround in the contract's preconditions); library/user-testing.md now records the toggle/observe/restore recipe.

discoveredIssues.description: Two smaller observations that were not counted as assertion failures: the sidebar renders Waitlist for a Host-preset role (VAL-CROSS-002's text says 'only Today and Book', though the waitlist link shares read:reservation:any and no forbidden surface appears), and deleting a location leaves its regional tenant rows behind (deleteScopeData only clears phone-agent data).
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Decide whether the waitlist entry is intended for the Host preset and, if not, gate it; if location deletion is meant to drop regional reservation data, extend deleteScopeData.
